originalTitle: Bond market anxiety is growing over AI capex budgets
summary: Google, Amazon and Meta are seeing credit spreads widen as fixed-income investors demand more reward on companies they lend to.
content:
Investors are getting increasingly uncomfortable with the amount of capital needed to make the artificial intelligence buildout a reality.

It's playing out in real time in the bond market, where the biggest names involved in the blitz — Google , Amazon and Meta — are seeing credit spreads widen as fixed-income investors demand more reward to lend to the companies.

Yields ticked higher this week after Alphabet lifted its capex forecast , raising concerns that other hyperscalers could follow suit.

Part of the reason capex budgets are going up is the rising cost of power. Energy is a major expense for all of the hyperscalers, which are constructing large data centers across the U.S. at breakneck speed.

GE Vernova CEO Scott Strazik told CNBC he expects the current inflationary environment to remain, driven in part by the heightened geopolitical backdrop. Just this week, oil broke above $100 a barrel.

The move in treasury yields is also inducing anxiety among fixed-income investors. Mizuho wrote to clients Friday morning that capex raises are testing investor limits as the companies, once seen as capital fortresses, are now seeing a dramatic rise in AI-tied costs.

The analysts added that the hyperscalers are currently on track to collectively spend more on capex than they generate in free cash flow by next year.

"It's creating intense discussions between bond and equity investors who have exposure to the biggest names in tech," said the portfolio manager of a credit fund, who asked to remain anonymous in order to discuss sensitive conversations.

As concerns grow, Oracle 's 5-year credit default swap, or CDS, is once again trading at a multi-year high.

In a note to clients published on Wednesday, Barclays credit analyst Andrew Keches wrote that Oracle's CDS is once again being seen as a proxy for AI debt fears.

"The appeal of ORCL CDS in recent history has extended beyond company-specific fundamentals, reflecting its role as a liquid hedge on AI capex, OpenAI execution and broader data-center spending narratives," wrote Keches.

Oracle is facing questions from investors about how active it plans to be in the debt market in the coming years, as the buildout and leasing of data centers continue to become more capital intensive.

Earlier this month, ratings agency S&P Global downgraded Oracle's credit rating to BBB-, just one notch above junk status.

Yet executives at the company remain confident in Oracle's ability to win the AI race. The company has a growing relationship with OpenAI and hyperscalers like Meta and Nvidia , which are also working with Oracle on cloud architecture.

Still, portfolio managers who spoke to CNBC said the move in tech bond yields could impact financing future deals.

Meta is looking to finance its $12 billion Texas data center with pricing expected to be finalized early next week, according to a source familiar with the talks, who asked not to be named in order to discuss the company's plans.

The Financial Times reported that the deal will be priced at a higher borrowing rate than previous projects, a sign that investors want not only demand more, but are questioning the return on investment.
chineseTitle: 债券市场对 AI 资本支出预算的焦虑日益加剧
chineseSummary: 由于固定收益投资者要求向其贷款的公司提供更多回报，谷歌、亚马逊和 Meta 的信用利差正在扩大。
chineseContent:
投资者对人工智能建设成为现实所需的资金量越来越感到不安。

它正在债券市场上实时上演，参与这场闪电战的大公司——谷歌、亚马逊和Meta——看到信用利差扩大，因为固定收益投资者要求向这些公司提供更多的贷款回报。

在 Alphabet 上调资本支出预测后，本周收益率小幅走高，引发了人们对其他超大规模企业可能效仿的担忧。

资本支出预算增加的部分原因是电力成本上升。能源是所有超大规模企业的一项主要支出，它们正在美国各地以极快的速度建设大型数据中心。

GE Vernova 首席执行官 Scott Strazik 告诉 CNBC，他预计当前的通胀环境将持续存在，部分原因是地缘政治背景加剧。就在本周，油价突破每桶100美元。

美国国债收益率的变动也引发了固定收益投资者的焦虑。瑞穗周五上午写信给客户称，资本支出的增加正在考验投资者的极限，因为这些曾经被视为资本堡垒的公司现在正面临与人工智能相关的成本急剧上升。

分析师补充说，到明年，超大规模企业目前在资本支出上的总体支出将超过其产生的自由现金流。

一家信贷基金的投资组合经理表示：“这在债券和股票投资者之间引发了激烈的讨论，这些投资者接触到了科技领域最知名的公司。”为了讨论敏感的对话，他要求保持匿名。

随着担忧的加剧，甲骨文的 5 年期信用违约掉期（CDS）再次创下多年高点。

巴克莱信贷分析师 Andrew Keches 在周三发布的一份给客户的报告中写道，甲骨文的 CDS 再次被视为人工智能债务担忧的代表。

Keches 写道：“ORCL CDS 在近代史上的吸引力已经超出了公司特定的基本面，反映出它作为 AI 资本支出、OpenAI 执行和更广泛的数据中心支出叙述的流动性对冲工具的作用。”

随着数据中心的扩建和租赁继续变得更加资本密集型，甲骨文正面临投资者的质疑，询问其未来几年计划在债务市场上的活跃程度。

本月早些时候，评级机构标准普尔全球公司将甲骨文的信用评级下调至 BBB-，仅比垃圾级高一级。

然而，该公司的高管仍然对甲骨文赢得人工智能竞赛的能力充满信心。该公司与 OpenAI 以及 Meta 和 Nvidia 等超大规模企业的关系日益密切，这些公司还与 Oracle 在云架构方面进行合作。

尽管如此，接受 CNBC 采访的投资组合经理表示，科技债券收益率的变动可能会影响未来交易的融资。

据一位熟悉谈判情况的消息人士透露，Meta 正在为其 120 亿美元的德克萨斯州数据中心寻求融资，定价预计将于下周初敲定。为了讨论该公司的计划，该消息人士要求匿名。

英国《金融时报》报道称，该交易的借款利率将高于之前的项目，这表明投资者不仅想要更多的需求，而且对投资回报率提出质疑。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
